name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
requirements: Valid .edu email or proof of current enrollment (school ID / transcript)
notes: Official GitHub Education program. Bundles free/discounted access to many third-party dev tools (not all listed here are guaranteed forever — GitHub periodically updates the pack).

name: Cursor Pro (Student Plan)
student_price: Free while enrolled (per Cursor's published student offer)
requirements: Verify with a school email via Cursor's own verification flow (e.g. SheerID or similar)
notes: Pricing and eligibility change over time — always confirm current terms on Cursor's site before assuming it's free.

name: Notion Plus/Education Plan
student_price: Free education plan for verified students/educators
requirements: Sign up with school email through Notion's education verification
notes: Historically called 'Notion Pro for students' in casual talk; check Notion's site for the exact current plan name and included AI features.

name: Figma Education
student_price: Free professional-tier access for verified students/teachers
requirements: Apply through Figma's education program with school affiliation
notes: Figma periodically reviews education eligibility; re-verification may be required.

name: Perplexity Pro (Student Discount)
student_price: Discounted (often bundled via partner promos, e.g. with a paired service)
requirements: Varies by current promo; usually requires school email or a partner subscription
notes: Perplexity's student offers have changed over time (sometimes bundled with other subscriptions). Confirm the live offer on their site rather than assuming a fixed discount.
